findings.quote: Att han låter ett enda stämmoprotokoll bära hela resonemanget om avvecklingen.
findings.note: Question style: this 11-word option is the SHORTEST in the whole unit, so the unit's per-question mean option length never falls below 13.25 words. Across all 94 authentic LÄS passages carrying 4+ questions the highest such floor is 11.8 words (median 5.6), so no authentic set is uniformly long the way this one is; the recension twin var-2013-verb1-LÄS-017..020 puts one-word options (Avlastande / Splittrande) beside a 16-word option in the same set. Recorded as minor, not major: this floor is a batch-wide generator house style (sibling floors 15.5 and 16.5) rather than a defect of this unit, and on every sub-metric las-b14-002 is now the most authentic-like LÄS unit in batch14.

comparative_note: The passage sits comfortably inside the exemplar range and is if anything richer in concrete residue than var-2019-verb1-LÄS-018: the review keeps a real historiographical tension open (Grimlund's sparbank explanation is contradicted by his own appendix, then partly conceded, then explicitly left undecidable) rather than resolving to a settled school-essay claim, which is the same move host-2020-verb2-LÄS-020 makes with its Norway comparison. Genre is fully attested — the corpus holds 19 authentic LÄS recensions of historical monographs, and the 875-word var-2013-verb1-LÄS-017..020 is a near-exact length and genre twin that likewise names the book in running prose rather than under a bibliographic header (only 3 of 19 use one). Both round-1 majors are verified cleared: q:4 now runs 13/13/14/13 words with single-clause options and no semicolons (authentic per-question max is p90=15, and a spread of 1 occurs in 23.7% of authentic LÄS questions, so this is ordinary rather than manufactured), and q2/A's longest shared run with the passage is now 2 tokens against an authentic median of 0 and p90 of 2. Stem vocabulary is authentic HP ('enligt texten' 139 occurrences, 'recensenten' 39), and q:3 is a structural twin of 'Vilket av följande ser recensenten som en svaghet i Ulf Andréassons avhandling?'.
